<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def block_state(f):
    pur=wh=0; purrows=[]; whrows=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in 'pW' and min(rows)>=33 and max(rows)<=44 and min(cols)>=26 and max(cols)<=37 and n['pixels']>20:
            if n['color']=='p': pur+=n['pixels']; purrows.append((min(rows),max(rows)))
            else: wh+=n['pixels']; whrows.append((min(rows),max(rows)))
    return (pur,wh,purrows,whrows)
print("before SPACE: block:", block_state(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE: block:", block_state(current_frame))
print("result:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
